task.details:
Ivan's directive 2026-09-07 (verbatim in docs/prompts/2026-09-07-ivan-directive-ten-store-versions.md): ten store versions with their own photos, colour theme, graphics and catalog copy as portfolio examples; role subagents on Opus or higher; quality over cost; autonomous to the result; first one version → Ivan's eyes → the other nine. Architect's decisions: docs/store-profiles/00-program-2026-09-07.md (F1 one DB per profile, F2 nano-banana-2 primary / flux-2-pro fallback / flux-1.1-pro-ultra raw for lifestyle, F3 bytes re-hosted to apps/backend/static + raw archive never deleted, F4 preset on the canon dictionary with the 88-variable bridge, F5 classic card in wave 1, F6 pilot = sneakers, F7 en+de/fr/es/ru, F8 stand :9023/:8028 in worktree feat/store-profiles). Proposed goal: the storefront on http://localhost:8028/en reads as a real sneaker brand's shop seeded from data/profiles/sneakers (14 products, sizes × colourways, ≥3 generated images each, copy matching the renders, own theme, hero and category tiles), verified from a fresh DB. Proposed acceptance (machine): store-profile:validate sneakers green with counts | seed into a fresh DB prints N products / M variants / K images | every image URL 200 | tsc, next lint, next build green | seed and storefront unit tests + Playwright profile specs green with reverse runs red | T0h.5 four-page pixel delta ≤ 0.1 % on medusa/light | verify report artifacts/docs/2026-09-07-store-profile-sneakers-verify.json with every check and its reverse run, counts copied. Proposed acceptance (Ivan's eyes on :8028): home reads as a sneaker brand's shop (photo banner + headline + button, four category tiles, product shelf) | one product's four photos show the same shoe and the swatches match the photos | every title names what its photo shows | descriptions read as written by a shop | size and colourway selectable, price changes | one palette on home, listing, product, cart | no clipped title or price at phone width. Orchestrator brief: docs/prompts/initial-prompt-2026-09-07-orchestrator-store-profiles.md. Estimates: est-store-profiles-pilot-sneakers, est-store-profiles-wave2-nine (@upready/estimation). Wave 2 (nine profiles, T0j card variants, T0i panel) starts only after Ivan accepts the pilot.

Ivan 2026-09-07 (after the cost breakdown): «давай пока только по 1 кадру все» → the pilot renders ONE frame per product (hero shot only; no angle, detail, lifestyle or colourway shots), one hero banner render, one render per category tile = 19 renders, at most 57 with regenerations (was 90–160). Acceptance lines replaced accordingly: 'every product has ≥1 image that loads' and 'on a product page the photo shows the shoe and the colourway named by the title and swatch'; layout hover = none. Brief S2/S3/S4/S5/S7, program F9/§5/§7/§8/§9, schemas (images minItems 1, shots minItems 1, counts.images min 10) and the estimate (tokens $16–47, renders 19–57) updated in the same turn.

Ivan 2026-09-07, second clarification: «по 1 кадру на изображение, т.е. по 1 ракурсу; перегенерации можно потом сделать вторым проходом, если будут ошибки» → exactly 19 renders in the pilot run, NO regenerations; a frame failing the checklist stays in the catalog marked flagged (manifest status accepted|flagged|rejected) and is listed in artifacts/media/sneakers/second-pass.json; the second pass is a separate order from Ivan. Brief S4, program F9/§9, media-manifest schema and the estimate notes updated.

Orchestrator session store-profiles (sid a37c19d2), 2026-09-07 20:2x-20:4x WITA. S0 DONE, measured: task todo->in_progress via the two-call unlock (marker + TASK_APPROVE_OK=1), orchestration consent marker taken; corepack pnpm install in the worktree only (Done in 14.6s, pnpm 10.11.1); envs copied from the main checkout and repointed (backend 27 keys: PORT=9023, DB_NAME/DATABASE_URL=upready_store_sneakers, STOREFRONT_URL=http://localhost:8028, STORE_PROFILE=sneakers, STORE_MEDIA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9023/static/store-profiles/sneakers; storefront 17 keys incl. NEXT_PUBLIC_STORE_PROFILE=sneakers and the publishable key read from api_key). GITIGNORE FINDING: the root rule for the profile media LOST to apps/backend/.gitignore:12 '!src/**' — git check-ignore -v showed media/*.webp TRACKED; fixed by appending the three media patterns plus static/ AFTER that line and re-measured by exit code (bytes IGNORED, manifest.json / catalog/products.json / design/style-board.md TRACKED). Commits 183ea30, ffd9df7. S0.5 baseline stand: createdb upready_store_sneakers, db:migrate exit 0, seed exit 0 -> 147 tables, 11 products, 36 variants, 30 images, 12 categories, 241 regions, 1 sales channel; medusa start CANNOT serve the admin here (serveProductionBuild looks at rootDirectory+ADMIN_RELATIVE_OUTPUT_DIR while medusa build writes .medusa/server/public/admin), so the stand runs medusa develop: 'Server is ready on port: 9023 - 5516ms', /health 200, /store/products count 11. next.config.js now honours NEXT_DIST_DIR so the two storefront agents build into .next-theme and .next-profile. ajv+ajv-formats+sharp added as devDeps of apps/backend by the orchestrator (agents may not edit package.json). Replicate: key (40 chars) verified with free GETs, versions nano-banana-2 d1be8b5f, flux-2-pro ccb5e331, flux-1.1-pro-ultra 551f15a1; input schemas captured (nano-banana-2 resolution 1K/2K/4K, aspect_ratio incl 1:1 4:5 16:9). PRICE STILL UNMEASURED — it is read from the first paid prediction at S4, never predicted. S1a/S1b/S1c/S2 running as four Opus subagents.

2026-09-07 20:42-21:00 WITA. S2 DONE+GATED, commit f66076f: style board 943 lines, 9 sections, 5 named-state mockup frames; brand Kerbstone (candidate Kerbline REJECTED — search hit Kerline, a live Polish footwear brand, plus a Tommy Hilfiger sneaker model, one letter apart in the same category); 32 contrast pairs computed by a script that exits non-zero on failure, min 4.67 at the 4.5 floor, two hexes changed because the FIRST run failed (light --destructive #EE0000->#D40000 4.24->5.53; light --primary flipped acid->ink after 'primary on background' scored 1.15 vs a 3.0 floor). Traps recorded for later stages: --accent is the shadcn HOVER SURFACE, not the brand accent (acid lives in --primary/--ring/--link/--success); --radius 0.25rem so theme.radius 'md' = 4px not Geist's 8px; token key set = full geist-kit set incl --link/--success/--warning/3x --shadow-*. Tile handles fixed for S3: low-tops, high-tops, runners, trail. S3 merchandiser LAUNCHED with a hard rule protecting Ivan's 19-render limit: imageBrief.shots must be EXACTLY one entry role hero. ORCHESTRATOR SMOKE RUN (rule 19c) of S1a's validate-store-profile.mjs: real path works (sneakers --skip-media -> exit 2, 'missing profile.json', correct since profile.json is an S6 deliverable) but NO-ARG invocation prints usage and exits 0 — a real defect queued for the S1 gate. CROSS-ZONE BLOCKER FIXED: globals.css imported themes.css BELOW the tailwind imports, which are inlined during processing, so Turbopack rejected the import and every route 500'd on :8031 and :8033 (measured). Import moved to first by the orchestrator (S1b still running, SendMessage to a live child would fork it — rule 22i). Risk that the bridge would stop overriding the preset was MEASURED in the served stylesheet, not assumed: bridge :root:not([data-theme-bridge=off]) is specificity (0,2,0) vs the preset's plain :root (0,1,0), so the override never depended on order; six theme blocks present (default/geist/medusa x light/dark); :8033/en -> 200. Re-verify at the S1 gate that the import is still first (S1b may rewrite globals.css) and that :8031/:8028 answer 200. S1c interim: 18 mockup frames, tsc 0, lint clean, 19 vitest green with 3 reverse runs, 13/14 Playwright green + 1 skipped; outstanding: 4 Playwright reverse runs + next build. NOT COMMITTED YET (correct per the brief — commits happen per zone AFTER gate S1): S1a seed machinery, S1b theme bridge, S1c blocks, S3 catalog. Work lives in the worktree, which survives a /clear.

2026-09-07 21:0x-21:2x WITA. THREE of four S1/S2/S3 zones CLOSED and independently re-verified by the orchestrator (agent numbers were recounted, not trusted). S1a commit 3d67e11, 24 files: STORE_PROFILE switch, derived regional prices, i18n merge, validate-store-profile.mjs, store-profile-up.mjs, two package scripts. Orchestrator re-ran the suite itself: 39 passed / 39 total, 3 suites, exit 0. S1a's own evidence: 27 reverse runs; probe A (STORE_PROFILE unset) reproduces the baseline exactly 147 tables / 11 products / 36 variants / 30 images / 12 categories / 241 regions; probe B seeded a throwaway profile live, 10 products / 40 variants, all 40 variants got 118 currencies (min=max=118), subtitle+specs verified over the store API, media 200 image/webp, second run idempotent ('already exists', same key). Currency decimals come from Medusa's defaultCurrencies (126 currencies, 39 zero-decimal), never a hand-written list; ratio table 241 region files / 118 currencies / 0 conflicts / usd t-shirt anchor 15; charm of 129 -> usd 128.99 eur 119.99 gbp 102.99 kwd 42.99 jpy 19349 krw 174579. Ajv strict needed one commented option: multipleOfPrecision 2, because multipleOf 0.01 rejects 129.99 in binary floating point. The validator exit-code defect the orchestrator found earlier was already fixed by S1a itself (both paths now exit non-zero); the earlier reading of exit 0 was taken from an in-progress version. S3 commit 616b09e, 10 files. Orchestrator recount from the JSON matches the report exactly: products 14, variants 225, imageRefs 14, shotShapes ['1:hero'], descMin 551, descMax 683, specMin 8, specMax 10, singleVariant 2, priceMin 9, priceMax 189, 5 locales. Categories: roots footwear (leaves low-tops, high-tops, runners, trail = the four home tiles) and accessories (leaf care-and-spares), 11 footwear + 3 accessories. Trademark scan 31 strings word-boundary over products.json + 5 locales, 0 real hits (a substring version had falsely flagged puma/fila inside espuma/fila de ojales/filature). gutter-low out of stock in EU 39 across all colourways, so the style board's 'size 39 out of stock' frame is backed by data. MUST REACH S4's PROMPT: style-board 5.4's packshot template hard-codes 'A single right shoe, alone in frame' after {subject}, which is WRONG for the three accessories — under Ivan's no-regeneration rule that would make 3 of 19 paid frames wrong with no retake; S4 needs a still-life variant for those three handles. QUEUED FOR S6: run validate-store-profile.mjs in place without --skip-media once profile.json/theme.json exist (S3's exit 0 came from a throwaway scratchpad fixture, nothing of it entered the repo); move the style board's persona price band ($140-$210) to match the brief's 89-189 USD that the data follows. STILL RUNNING: S1b (theme bridge; measured 113 preset variables not the brief's 88 — 88 counts only colour groups, effects add 25; 26 mapped / 59 diverged / 28 open; geist vendored from geist-kit@b0e687b; 37 tests with 9/9 reverse runs) and S1c (18 mockup frames, tsc 0, lint clean, 19 vitest green with 3 reverse runs, 13/14 Playwright green + 1 skipped; outstanding: 4 Playwright reverse runs and next build). NOT PUSHED: the launch order says no push; Ivan asked whether to switch to GitHub PRs but has not ordered it — see the open question.
